title: Impressions & Karma
description: Understand the subtle imprints left by your actions and learn how to navigate the law of karma to create a life of purpose and freedom.

sutra.meaning: Memory is unmodified, retained experience. It is the collection of the modulations and impressions of correct knowledge, perverse knowledge, illusory knowledge and sleep.

sections.insight: Past impressions influence present behavior. When awake if the mind is in any of the four modulations  then that is not meditation. It is not Yoga.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What memory got triggered in me today?
sections.gurudevInsight: Anything can change anytime in any manner. The whole world is a field of all probabilities, possibilities, but your mind fixes things & people & ideas & places, everything into definite items, quantities, quantifies them, this is how this is, sets ideas using the proof, or the wrong knowledge or the vikalpa -fantasies or fears or dwelling in the past experiences. [PDF p.12]

sutra.meaning: When mind becomes clear it reflects reality like a crystal-  As realisation dawns that the knower , the instrument of knowing and the known are but one.

sections.insight: When the mind is pure it reflects truth without distortion.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Is my perception clear or colored?
sections.shlokaFrom: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः।छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
sections.wisdomFrom: The sages whose sins are destroyed, whose doubts are dispelled, whose minds are disciplined, and who rejoice in the welfare of all beings, attain liberation in Brahman.
sections.gurudevInsight: If you do this, you chita, your mind will be pleasant. In that gracious, graceful mind, one pointedness becomes very much easy, very simple, hmm! Practice one thing or devotion to one thing or one aspect. Ok, Even that becomes difficult, he says, there is another sutra. “Prachardanvidharanbhya va pranasya” Breaking the rhythms of the breath, the natural rhythms of the breath & holding the breath, sustaining the breath in different rhythms. If someone asks you, where did Patanjali talked about kriya, Patanjali has not mentioned about Sudarshan kriya directly. [PDF p.40]

sutra.meaning: Mixed perception including words, meaning and content  becomes a special knowledge at this stage called savitarka samadhi. .

sections.insight: This is a very refined state of consciousness.
sections.gurudevInsight: Every possible obstacle has been counted, included in these 9 categories. Just few words, very few words, very concisely he has said all that in to be said, that was needed to be said. Along with these nine obstacles, the 5 indications or signs of disturbed mind is mentioned i.e. 1) Dukha: Sadness/Sorrow 2) daurmanasya: Bitterness 3) agmajayatva: Restlessness in the body or lack of coordination in the body and 4) shwasprashwas: Irregular breathing. [PDF p.36]

sections.theme: Let go of what the past left behind.

sutra.meaning: When memory is purified only truth shines Let go of past recordings to see clearly. This is nirvitarka samadhi.

sections.insight: Let go of past filters to see the present clearly as it is. When memory is cleansed the consciousness shines without reflection.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Do I think too much of what has passed.
sections.gurudevInsight: So that person thinks Oh yes, see I am very miserable. You do not help them in any way to wake up to the truth, its nothing; many people are suffering even more. I am not saying you don’t go or you go & tell them that your suffering is nothing, many people are suffering more. But have compassion for people who are suffering & not friendliness. And People who are doing good job, meritorious jobs, who have lots of merits, who are blessed, feel happy with them, become one with them, feel you are doing that job with them. Then the sense of competition disappears, jealousy subsides, finding faults with people who are doing good things will go away. [PDF p.38]

sutra.meaning: New impressions override old patterns..In fact the insight of the cleansed intellect negates all  residue action and prevents new ones taking root.

sections.gurudevInsight: See, you can see the same Self in everybody but the feelings will not be the same. One does not feel the same with everybody though intellectually you may say its myself only there but you’re feelings, since it is not fully cultured, fully established in the Self, it still has its preferences, its ways. Says - be friendly with those who are happy. If you are friendly with unhappy people what happens? So he says don’t be friendly with unhappy people but be compassionate to them. People who are suffering, have sympathy, compassion for them, but don’t hook on to friendliness because then it drags you down and makes you unhappy. [PDF p.37]

sutra.meaning: However, when even the new found wisdom is dropped it leads to a seedless state or nirbeej samadhi.

sections.insight: Ultimate stillness is beyond all patterns.
sections.gurudevInsight: 44 Do nothing & let go of all that like you did in sleep. Knowledge of sleep that leads to samadhi. Ignorant people make a dream reality & enlightened people see this reality as a dream. Utter ignorance is trying to interpret the dream & the enlightened means, is to realize this reality itself is a dream. You go to an enlightened person & tell them this is my dream, he’ll say oh, forget about it, wake up. And if you go to someone who is in dream interpretation. [PDF p.45]

sutra.sanskrit:
क्लेशमूलः कर्माशयो दृष्टादृष्टजन्मवेदनीयः
सति मूले तद्विपाको जात्यायुर्भोगाः
ते ह्लादपरितापफलाः पुण्यापुण्यहेतुत्वात्
sutra.meaning:
Karma is rooted in suffering,it determines life experiences.
Karma determines if actions bring joy or suffering

sections.insight:
Actions leave impressions which accumulate and will be experienced in present and future lives
Patterns shape life.
Choices shape experience.
sections.reflectionPrompt:
What action affected me?
What patterns repeat in my life?
sections.gurudevInsight: There is a depth in you, a silent corner in you, that is the Seer & that is true – this whole space is so silent, in the silent space the entire activity is happening, every atom is revolving around the nucleus, all the planets are moving around & yet it is all very silent. The purpose of this is kleshatanukarana - to reduce the suffering or misery in life & samadhibhavana - to bring about samadhi, harmony, equanimity in life. What are the root causes of misery in life? “Avidyaasmitaragadweshabhinivesha panchklesha” 1) Ignorance :-Avidya - is root cause of suffering. [PDF p.67]

sutra.meaning: An sadhak has the discriminating ability to differentiate between his consciousness and his sensory organs He recognizes the potential for distress which all worldly activities and the resulting impressions pose.

sections.insight: A wise person will have to exert to stop impulsive motivations from time to time, It is , ofcourse not possible , at all times, to suppress the urges arising out of his mind and emotions but awareness that they will result in sorrow will serve as a deterence.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I always aware of the choices I am making. How often do I make impulsive decisions.
sections.practice: Stop and weigh every decision as to their long term consequences,
sections.journalPrompt: Did I make considered decisions today.
sections.shlokaFrom: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि॥
sections.wisdomFrom: Those who have no faith in this dharma, O Parantapa, without attaining Me, return to the path of this world of death.
sections.gurudevInsight: Senseless arguments comes because they are so stuck thinking that is their intellect, their Intellect as themselves, thoughts as themselves, my thought, my position, me, me. Inability to see the Self, & the buddhi or the intellect & the power of the instrument of perception as separate is Asmita. Craving: - Raga, craving: - and craving comes with a pleasant experience. You have a pleasant experience & that creates a craving in you & this craving makes you miserable, this is beautiful. Patanjali has said, there are only 5 sources of misery, there is no 6th source of misery. Ignorance is thinking that which is changing as non-changing. [PDF p.68]
